name: Whorl
author: E. T. Carter
description: A phyllotaxis bloom: two hundred glowing motes placed by the golden-angle spiral form a sunflower seed head drawn in light. Each dot ignites at the centre, brightens through mid-life, and dims away at the rim as the whole population streams outward at a felt-not-seen pace.

params.label: Bloom speed
params.effect: How fast each dot ages and rides the spiral outward; the entire population streams faster at higher values.

params.label: Dot size
params.effect: Radius of each glowing mote in CSS px; larger dots overlap into a softer continuous bloom.

params.label: Spread
params.effect: Radial spacing constant of the phyllotaxis in CSS px per square-root-index step; sets the seed head's overall footprint and dot density.
